svg.title:  under congruence. Two have rank one and the third has rank one or two, proving the last statement. □ For a non-trace-preserving branch with faithful input effect on its two-dimensional input support, an invertible input whitening makes it trace preserving without changing ranks or distinct pure rays. In a putative equality profile (a, b) = (1, 2), two other output planes project to distinct rays in this branch’s input plane, and equality requires their posterior outputs to have rank two. Thus the lemma applies to that branch. It is only a necessary normal form: its output-congruenced diagonal structure is not literal commutativity of the physical output states, and no global full-law realization follows from it alone.
